_note: Middle East, China/Iran and food supply claims from July 2026 videos. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Mohammed bin Salman leads a formation of Arab leaders into a Middle East agreement, heading the group like the point of a V.
mentions.quote: I saw MBS leading in a V. He was the leader
mentions.falsify_match: A Saudi-led multi-nation Middle East accord.

mentions.claim_text: Oil derricks rise out of Gaza with a large amount of money in oil and gas underneath it, alongside a rebuilt coastal development with a Trump-branded golf course and an Israeli flag in the ninth hole.
mentions.quote: oil derricks, but they were coming up out of Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: Hydrocarbon extraction and a large development project in Gaza.
mentions.falsify_miss: No drilling or development of that kind.

mentions.claim_text: An attack on Israel comes in the night that is worse than October 7th and uses chemical weapons.
mentions.quote: I saw a attack coming in the night that was worse than October 7th
mentions.falsify_match: A mass-casualty chemical attack on Israel exceeding October 7th.

mentions.claim_text: He reads the Welsh drought, reported as the driest in 190 years, as weather manipulation and as the black horse riding.
mentions.quote: the worst drought in over a hundred years... weather manipulation and weather warfare
mentions.falsify_match: The Welsh drought record confirms the severity he cites.
mentions.falsify_miss: The drought claim is not borne out in the record.

mentions.claim_text: Drone strikes carrying chemical weapons come in the days ahead against US troops and surrounding areas.
mentions.quote: I saw drone strikes trying to come in the days ahead with chemical weapons
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical drone attack on US forces in the region.
mentions.falsify_miss: No chemical attack on US forces.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw boots on the ground being contemplated with Saudi Arabia, and points to Saudi joining US strikes on Iranian proxies in Iraq as that arriving.
mentions.quote: I saw boots on the ground contemplating with Saudi Arabia in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi ground participation alongside US forces.
mentions.falsify_miss: Saudi stays out of ground operations.

mentions.claim_text: Long range missiles fly after a Russian action, drawing in France, Ukraine, the United Kingdom and Australia, with America joining and a draft being called because of Iran.
mentions.quote: because of what's going on in Iran... they had to call a draft
mentions.falsify_match: A multi-nation war drawing in the US with conscription reinstated.
mentions.falsify_miss: No draft and no multi-nation entry.

mentions.claim_text: Cyber attacks come against the FAA, with darkness over Cuba and a city so dark that light is being thrown against buildings.
mentions.quote: I saw the FAA, cyber attacks coming to the FAA
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack disrupting FAA systems.
